note: Primary inputs for the BedWatch pitch. GFW fishing-effort tiles need a free API token; the public map does not.

sources.name: Global Fishing Watch Map
sources.how: Open the map, search Palk Bay / India EEZ, filter Apparent fishing effort → gear type Trawlers. Share the workspace URL for judges. AIS undercounts many small trawlers in South and Southeast Asia.
sources.license: View free; API token for tiles/reports

sources.name: GFW 4Wings API
sources.how: Dataset public-global-fishing-effort:latest, filter geartype in ('trawlers'). Token at globalfishingwatch.org/our-apis. Use reports for EEZ/custom polygons, not vessel targeting.

sources.name: UNEP-WCMC Global Distribution of Seagrasses v7.1
sources.how: Ocean Data Viewer is the official demo. FeatureServer layer 0 = points, layer 1 = polygons. Query GeoJSON with an envelope (Palk Bay 78–81.5E, 8–11N). Coverage in SE Asia is known to be incomplete vs local surveys.

sources.name: Allen Coral Atlas
sources.how: Benthic maps include seagrass for 2019–2020 and 2023–2024 (Sentinel-2). Best visual demo of meadow extent in Palk Bay / Gulf of Mannar. Download via the Atlas after accepting terms.
sources.license: Atlas terms; cite Peng et al. 2026 for global seagrass extent

sources.name: Protected Planet / WDPA
sources.how: Search Mannar Valaiguda (Ramsar). Marine national park names are often missing or differently spelled in the marine WDPA extract — treat MPA coverage as a lower bound.

sources.name: Hiddink et al. 2017 (PNAS) relative benthic status
sources.how: Supplies the depletion-per-pass and recovery logic used in model.js / model/rbs.py. Not a spatial dataset.
sources.license: Paper; parameters used as a screening approximation
